title: teslalog: Efficiency
description: Derived efficiency figures from drive battery/range deltas - teslalog stores the same raw columns TeslaMate's own efficiency panel computes from, but doesn't pre-compute this itself (see README's Data model section).

targets.queryText: SELECT efficiency_wh_km AS value FROM vehicles ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT efficiency_wh_km AS value FROM vehicles ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(AVG((start_battery_level - end_battery_level) * 1.0 / distance_km), 0) AS value
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed' AND distance_km > 1 AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COALESCE(AVG((start_battery_level - end_battery_level) * 1.0 / distance_km), 0) AS value
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed' AND distance_km > 1 AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Avg rated-range km lost per km driven (90d)

targets.queryText:
SELECT COALESCE(AVG((start_range_km - end_range_km) / distance_km), 0) AS value
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed' AND distance_km > 1 AND start_range_km IS NOT NULL AND end_range_km IS NOT NULL
  AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT COALESCE(AVG((start_range_km - end_range_km) / distance_km), 0) AS value
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed' AND distance_km > 1 AND start_range_km IS NOT NULL AND end_range_km IS NOT NULL
  AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  start_time AS time,
  ROUND(distance_km, 1) AS "km",
  (start_battery_level - end_battery_level) AS "% used",
  ROUND(CASE WHEN distance_km > 0 THEN (start_battery_level - end_battery_level) * 1.0 / distance_km ELSE NULL END, 3) AS "%/km",
  ROUND(start_range_km - end_range_km, 1) AS "rated km lost"
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed' AND distance_km > 0
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 200
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
